## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue if available.

## Verification

List commands/checks actually run and their results. State anything not verified.

## Compatibility and rollback

Describe affected public or data contracts, possible regressions and the rollback path. Write "Not applicable" where appropriate.

## Development contract

- [ ] I followed [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/dejurin/wordpress-plugin-exchange-rates/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md), or documented an exception for maintainer review.
- [ ] Development artifacts and source UI strings use English; localization and upstream content remain intact.
- [ ] Applicable WordPress conventions, DRY, security, compatibility and data-integrity requirements were reviewed.
- [ ] Relevant documentation and verification evidence are included; skipped checks are explained.
- [ ] No secrets or development-only files entered the plugin package; WordPress.org SVN was not modified.
